packageRules.description: Automerge patch updates of dev dependencies (Cargo and Bun)
A new Fedora bootc digest can bring a new kernel; molt/kernel.lock must be bumped in the same PR
prBodyNotes: If the build fails on `molt/kernel.lock`, the base image ships a new kernel: check OpenZFS supports it, then update the lock in this PR.

customManagers.description: bootc-image-builder digest pinned in xtask (cargo xtask molt)
